subject.title: feat(diagnostics-prometheus): attach the agent label to model-call, tool-execution, and run metric families

question: Should agent identity become a supported dimension of run and model-call diagnostic events and their Prometheus metric families?
rationale: Tool execution already carries agent identity, but extending the run and model-call event contracts defines telemetry semantics and accepts a deployment-sized cardinality increase; source inspection cannot decide that product policy.

options.title: Attribute all requested families
options.body: Add optional agent identity consistently to run, model-call, and tool-execution metrics with bounded-cardinality tests and documentation.

options.title: Attribute tool metrics only
options.body: Expose the already-available tool event identity but retain fleet-wide run and model-call metrics until their semantics are separately designed.

options.title: Keep fleet-wide semantics
options.body: Leave these families unchanged and document that reliability and latency metrics intentionally aggregate across agents.

recommendation.title: Attribute all requested families
recommendation.body: Add optional agent identity consistently to run, model-call, and tool-execution metrics with bounded-cardinality tests and documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal is recent adjacent work spanning lifecycle observability and diagnostics exporters.
